نختطي (form VIII)
# نَخْتَطِي (naḵtaṭī) /nax.ta.tˤiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَطَى (iḵtaṭā)
# نَخْتَطِيَ (naḵtaṭiya) /nax.ta.tˤi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَطَى (iḵtaṭā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
